title: Finding Structure in Time
blurb: Introduced the simple recurrent network, whose hidden state feeds back as context so the network can discover structure in sequences.
intro: An Elman network copies its hidden layer into a context layer that is fed back at the next step, giving the recurrence $h_t = \tanh(x_tW_{xh} + h_{t-1}W_{hh} + b)$. Training it means backpropagating through the unrolled sequence, and the gradients through many steps tend to vanish or explode. The steps build the cell, a language model and training with truncated BPTT and clipping; the capstone computes full BPTT gradients and shows the vanishing effect.

steps.name: Score a batch with an RNN language model
